senses.gloss: sec. r. of בול, ביל; √בו, בה, cmp. בִּין, to penetrate, break through, v. בלט;
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: √בל to crumble, soften, cmp. √מל; v. בלי, נבל, בלט in בולטיתא) to mix (with oil), knead, stir; to mix fodder.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 14:3">Zeb. XIV, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Zevachim 112b">112ᵇ</cite>) <he>הבּוֹלֵל</he> the priest who kneads the meat-offering with oil, v. <cite ref="B00862"><he>בְּלִילָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:5">Dem. V, 5</cite> <he>בולל ונוטל</he> (strike out <he>ואוכל</he> in Bab. ed., Ar. Var. <he>בורר</he>) he mixes the fruits and takes the tithe.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:1:6">Y. B. Kam. IV, beg. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>לִבְלוֹל</he> to mix up (coins in a bag.) <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:2:2">Y. R. Hash. I, 56ᵈ</cite> bot.; Tanḥ. Noah 11, v. <cite ref="B00254"><he>בּוּל</he> III</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="B00830"><he>בָּלוּל</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="B01383"><he>בְּלוּלָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 24a">Snh. 24ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="B00061"><he>בבל</he></cite>) <he>ב׳ במקרא וכ׳</he> mixed up (confused) in Bible study &c. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:6:5">Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9ᵈ</cite> <he>קריבה בבלל</he>, read <he>בכָלִיל</he>.] V. <cite ref="B00830"><he>בָּלוּל</he></cite>.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: , Hof. הוּבְלָל to be mixed. Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᶜ, v. חָפַן.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 12:4">Men. XII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 103b:18">103ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 18b:1">18ᵇ</cite>) <he>ששים נבללין</he> sixty measures of flour can be thoroughly mixed; v. <cite ref="B00615"><he>בִּילָה</he></cite>.

Ib. יכולים לְהִבָּלֵל.—Y. Shek. VI, 49ᵈ bot. אש מוּבְלָלָה באש fire mixed with fire.—[Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ bot. עד שיִבָּלֲלוּ וכ׳ until your speech shall become confounded from repeatedly saying, Enough; v. בלי.] Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵃ top (play on בַּל) יִבָּלֲלוּ וכ׳ all blessings shall be kneaded thogether—Pilp. בִּלְבֵּל.
